title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta36

## Documentation and release-candidate cleanup

This prerelease reconciles the public Navimower documentation with the stable 0.4.3 baseline and the cumulative 0.4.4 development line through beta35. Runtime mower behavior is unchanged from beta35.

- Refresh the README around the integration's current effective behavior instead of preserving intermediate beta experiments as user-facing guidance.
- Document the current georeference/provider-frame model, WGS84/geographic underlays, multi-mower Site API behavior, Map underlay Options Flow and authenticated Google Satellite proxy.
- Document the phased Map API/current-cycle rendering contract, reset-based trail cycles and monotonic `Last completed` semantics.
- Bring Navimower Schedule documentation up to the current positional queue model, immutable per-round queue snapshots, repeated rounds, retained-task ownership and conservative charging/window resume behavior.
- Document `Mowing pause reason`, current notification/error semantics, internal map zone-ID validation for `navimower.mow`, and first-generation H-series mower-controlled zone ordering.
- Clarify the separation between sanitized cached-only Home Assistant Download diagnostics, temporary Passive protocol discovery and the explicit sensitive `navimower.export_raw_data` development action.

## Gate areas and physical-gate example

- Document exact polygon Gate areas as the current model while retaining legacy rectangular compatibility.
- Treat the Navimower Map Card visual editor as the preferred normal drawing path, while keeping the Options Flow as a manual/fallback editor and retaining the `navimower.set_gate_area` / `navimower.delete_gate_area` backend actions.
- Replace the primary physical-gate guide with the current helperless ownership pattern: if the physical gate is closed when the mower enters the Gate area, the same automation run pauses, opens, resumes, waits for the mower to leave and then closes the gate. If the gate was already open or otherwise not closed, that run owns nothing and cannot close somebody else's gate later.
- Keep the older `Gate required` + Custom Area pattern as an alternative for work with one unambiguous mowing target, including the proven vendor pause-state confirmation before resuming.

## Supporting documentation

- Add `docs/MAP_GEOREFERENCE_AND_UNDERLAYS.md` for georeference sources, provider frames, underlays and troubleshooting.
- Refresh `docs/MULTI_MOWER.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/DIAGNOSTICS_PRIVACY.md` to match the current integration contracts.

## Compatibility and next stable release

- No stable 0.4.4 release is made by this prerelease.
- The final Navimower 0.4.4 / Navimower Map Card stable pairing remains intentionally undecided until the 0.3.6 Map Card development line is audited together with the integration.
- This beta exists so the cleaned integration documentation and release-candidate wording can receive one more prerelease cycle before the coordinated stable releases.
